dataset: UCI SMS Spam Collection (public, generic English SMS spam) via spam.csv
dataset_limitation: This dataset is NOT Bangladesh-specific and does not represent bKash/Nagad/Rocket-style financial phishing. It is a general spam/ham corpus; 'spam' includes premium-rate/dating/prize spam, not exclusively financial fraud.
vectorizer: TF-IDF, ngram_range=(1,2), max_features=4000, min_df=2, fit on train split only
